toGa4.title: Also send them to Google Analytics 4
toGa4.description: Each Web Vital also goes to Google Analytics 4 as an event of its name (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB) with its value, rating and id (metric_id, and event_category web-vitals with event_label), while Google Analytics is loaded (Google tags, after consent). Works without Visitor analytics: then nothing is kept in your database.
